scope: Read-only Agent trace delivery/accounting for saved actual app submissions. No model calls, init, flush, feedback writes or telemetry replay. One span query per completed conversation; cached results retain individual observation timestamps.
comparison_encoding: Decode exact-once telemetry copies at their known trace_text/trace_json layers; original backend records are not modified.
limitations: Trace delivery and runtime completion fields do not prove answer quality, code correctness, or task completeness; see independent manual review.
Model usage/cost reconciliation uses returned usage and estimates, not an invoice.
No legacy Calls, Evaluation rows or online Signal feedback queried in this bounded app readback.
Missing remote IDs remain unverified; this snapshot does not establish whether export loss or indexing delay caused absence.
